name: Runemaster audit: Primal Rune adds -10 to Granite Resolve's damage-taken reduction (#2769)
contract: Primal Rune 705636 effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER, EffectMiscValue 3 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT1), EffectBasePoints -11 + DieSides 1 = -10, EffectSpellClassMask word 2 bit 31 (2147483648). Granite Resolve 520229 has SpellFamilyName 38, SpellFamilyFlags word 2 bit 31 (2147483648) - an exact classmask match. Player::ApplySpellMod, which the spell_modifier metric calls, must therefore subtract 10 more from any op-3 query against 520229 once 705636 is learned.

steps.label: before: 520229 has no modifier for op 3
705636 op 3 flat -10 reaches 520229 (classmask matches Granite Resolve's family flags)
